evidence_gaps: no efflux-pump expression assay (RT-qPCR/RNA-seq of mmpS5-mmpL5 vs a wild-type control)
no MIC shift assay with an efflux-pump inhibitor (e.g. verapamil)
no allelic-exchange or CRISPRi knockdown of the specific missense allele to isolate its effect from background variation
resolving_experiments: RT-qPCR or RNA-seq of mmpS5-mmpL5 expression in Rv0678 mutant vs wild-type background
